title: Government Of India Act 1858
definition: An Act for the Better Government of India passed by the British Parliament following the Revolt of 1857, liquidating the East India Company's rule and transferring direct governance of British India to the British Crown.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial foundational landmark tested in Prelims regarding structural shifts in imperial administration (Secretary of State, Viceroy, abolition of Dual Government) and in Mains GS-1/GS-2 for analyzing the evolution of British colonial policy and constitutional development.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and institutional changes brought by the Government of India Act 1858.
Evaluate the shift from Company rule to Crown rule and its long-term administrative consequences.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding the Secretary of State and Governor-General.
